svg.text: Phase 0 call flow — netcheck over UDP, bench → V2X
What Phase 0 actually ran: one throwaway image on both nodes, plain ASCII payloads. No CPM, no codec, no contract on the wire.
forces a kernel route lookup and sends nothing —
an unreachable peer fails instantly, with no ICMP involved
13 bytes of ASCII · sent at HZ=1, one per second
the relay appends its own role, never re-encodes:
forwarded onward to ADA on :47200 as
Throughout, tcpdump runs in the background on both nodes, prefixing every packet line with [CAP] — proof on the wire, independent of the application's own log.
The accumulated stamp is the evidence: a payload reading seq=288|bench|v2x at ADA proves the datagram transited every node, not merely that one arrived from somewhere.
